mainEntity.name: What is the typical remodeling process, from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The remodeling process generally begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision and goals. This is followed by design and planning, where blueprints, material selections, and a detailed scope of work are developed. After design approval, permits are secured. Construction then commences, involving demolition, framing, system installations (electrical, plumbing), inspections, and finishing touches. The process concludes with a final walkthrough and project completion, ensuring everything meets your expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, design and planning, permit acquisition, construction (demolition, framing, systems, finishes), inspections, and a final walkthrough.
